findings.current: They stepped onto a path they had never wanted to take, then lost their way forever.
findings.defect: The translation omits the preceding sentence identifying this as the end of a revenge fiend. That framing is part of the source’s conclusion to the Head Elder’s story and introduces the metaphor that follows.
findings.rationale: The source says, “그것이 복수귀(復讐鬼)의 최후다” (“That is the end of a revenge fiend”) before describing how they lose their way.
findings.replacement: That is how a revenge fiend meets his end. They stepped onto a path they had never wanted to take, then lost their way forever.

findings.current: It wasn’t because I had possessed enough strength to make that choice.
findings.defect: The translation omits that Jin Taekyung was alone at the time and took each step without the slightest hesitation. Both details establish the resolve behind his choice.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says he was alone and his steps held no hesitation before explaining that his choice came from anger over Kim Hwajong’s death.
findings.replacement: Back then, I had been alone, but there had not been even a trace of hesitation in my steps. It wasn’t because I had possessed enough strength to make that choice.

summary: The assembled copy has two meaningful omissions that the accepted baseline preserved.
